notes.title: Mini update: Leaderboards and QoL
notes.content:
+ The harbor can be closed with esc. (Escape)
+ Added Leaderboards

- Removed feature that made other ships able to push the player out of the harbor.
- Removed feature that made enemies spawn on islands again.


You will get an entry on the leaderboard once you kill your first enemy. It will however take the in-game counter for your leaderboard entry.

notes.title: Mini update: New voiceactors and bugfixes
notes.content:
In this patch not much changed. We changed the voiceacting to something... a little more professional, and we fixed a few bugs making it possible to get money faster than intended.

The game will not automatically reset. If you want to experience the new voices reset it in the menu (Esc button).

notes.title: Update 0.7 "Wood for everyone"
notes.content:
+ New item: Wood. It can be bought for 6 gold and sold for 2.
+ Repairs now require wood. 2HP = 1 Wood. Therefor repairing yourself is 1 gold (25%) cheaper/HP than the instaheal.
+ The information panel in the harbor shows how many fish/gold you own.
+ The harbor now has a button for resources (fish and wood) Weapons (Cannons) and Miscallaneous (Everything else). The brown bar at the right is for scrolling, but because there is enough space for everything its useless.
+ The inventory is now better labeled so you actually know if your items are equipped or not.
+ A controls menu has been implemented. The controls cannot be altered yet but its a good way to look up how they work.

~ Fixed an issue with what you got 4 billion fish if you sold them while finishing the 1st quest.
~ Doubled repair speed.
~ Fixed an issue that showed "Toast" or the last message that was displayed after respawning.

- Had to reset all savefiles for all players. This is due to the infinite Fish bug. Im working on a compensation for this kind of stuff for future updates if it happens again.

Informations:
Restarting currently also resets your settings. Fix will be in fututre updates. (Hopefully)
We saw all your reports about bad communication and an even worse tutorial. This will also be addressed in (hopefullyy) the next week.
If you close the game via windows (The red X on the top right, alt + F4, or task manager) it can be that some stuff gets saved, like quests or stuff you get via quests, but other things like your resources/gold will be lost. So always try to quit via the ingame method. This will save everything

notes.title: Patch 0.6 "More and better"
notes.content:
+ Not accepted quest are found in the tavern now. The story will automatically progress, everytime there is something new, after it has been activated.
+ New story-quest for the beginning. You first get a fishing rod and then a cannon for free.
+ Quests pick off from where you left if you close the game.
+ Stored items are now saved as such. No need to store them again on restart.
	
- Removed the rod you get at the beginning because you get it via Quests now.

notes.title: Patch 0.5 "Get working"
notes.content:
+ Quests (A single quest currently, but will become more.) The first quest can immediately be found when opening the inventory (Stats & Storage menu). A voiceline for it will start the moment you move your ship the first time.
+ The ship now has a limited amount of fish to discourage AFKing. The Sloop can carry 30 fish and the Giekewer 80. However if you pick up loot from enemies you can carry more.
+ UI for the Tavern. A place where you will be able to start future quests.
+ UI for the Inventory (Stats and storage UI) that displays a list of all currently active quests.
+ Option to change volume of music/voices respectively.

~ Changed the Stats & Storage button to a visual button.
~ Bugfixes

notes.title: Update 0.4 "The storage update"
notes.content:
Last weeks patch wasn't really much and I promised you quests and a new UI to store your stuff and look everything up. I only got the UI for storage working sadly. On the weekend there will be a patch that introduces new enemies because you are pretty OP at this point. Until the next real patch I hope to get done some stuff that was promised before. Bu for now you get this new UI.

All graphics in that UI are placeholders and the whole thing is subject to change.

notes.title: Hotfix to gamebreaking bug intrduced in 0.3.1
notes.content: The update yesterday introduced a bug that, instead of killing your current enemy, just produced an infinite amount of new enemies until the game crashed. This bug has been fixed. The version has been updated to 0.3.2.

notes.title: Changelog 0.3.1
notes.content:
I couldn't get the planned features in this week. The next week is very stressfull too but I will do my best to implement new features to make the game more fun and last longer! But therefor this weeks patch only contains minor improvements on the bugged side of life:

+   Added a loading bar.

~    This time really fixed the issue that you sometimes spawned on the island.
~    Therefor also fixed the same bug with enemies.
~    Fixed bugs that a ship could have too many items when loading older saves.

-    Removed unity logo from splash screen

Keep in mind if your old spawn location is saved on the island just press "Suicide" and you will spawn on the sea. There is no penalty for doing so yet(!)
If I make it next weeks update will contain quests for the beginning part of the game (with a full on story coming with it) and a new interface where you can see your stats and change to older ships!

notes.title: Changelog version 0.3
notes.content:
+ New Ship, the "Giekewer".
+ Sails. One Sail improves your speed by 15% basespeed.
+ New map.
+ New water textures.
+ This changelog, duh.
+ "Anti softlock" (suicide) button.

~ "Fixed" spawning on islands.
~ Fixed issues with the savefile.
~ Doubled the drops from enemies to make combat more appealing.
~ Reduced amount of fishing rods on the sloop to 4.
~ Changed the discord Icon to something bigger.

- Removed the old map.
- Removed the old water textures.
